v1FieldOperator.description:
- FIELD_OPERATOR_EQUALS: Basic comparison operators

= (equality)
 - FIELD_OPERATOR_NOT_EQUALS: != (inequality)
 - FIELD_OPERATOR_IN: Set membership operators

IN (value in list) - value format: "val1,val2,val3"
 - FIELD_OPERATOR_NOT_IN: NOT IN (value not in list) - value format: "val1,val2,val3"
 - FIELD_OPERATOR_CONTAINS: String matching operators

LIKE %value% (substring match)
 - FIELD_OPERATOR_STARTS_WITH: LIKE value% (prefix match)
 - FIELD_OPERATOR_ENDS_WITH: LIKE %value (suffix match)
 - FIELD_OPERATOR_EXISTS: Null checking operators

IS NOT NULL (field has value)
 - FIELD_OPERATOR_NOT_EXISTS: IS NULL (field is null)
v1FieldOperator.title: FieldOperator defines the comparison operation for field selectors
